# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 73 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_073_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 73

**1** Jesus said: "The harvest is great but the laborers are few.

**2** Beseech the Lord to send laborers into the harvest."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**"Laborers"** — EMET preferred over "workers" (LOGOS/PNEUMA): the Coptic *ergate* carries the full sense of agricultural laborers, which "workers" dilutes.

**"Beseech"** — EMET preferred over "pray" (LOGOS) or "ask" (PNEUMA): the intensity of petition is appropriate here.

**Text:** Thomas's omission of "of the harvest" after Lord is significant: it makes the saying more universally theological, addressing any Lord rather than specifying the harvest-Lord.

**Synoptic Parallels:** One of the clearest Q parallels in Thomas (Matt 9:37-38; Luke 10:2). Minor differences only.
